subject: Vendor onboarding: VAT evidence and PO entity mapping for Omnicommerce Ltd
messages:
From: Ethan Walsby <supply@omnicommerce.co.uk>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Vendor onboarding - VAT evidence + PO mapping questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for starting the onboarding process for Omnicommerce Ltd. We're excited to get set up as a Redwood supplier. A couple of items came up during our AP review that we wanted to confirm so invoices and POs route correctly to the right legal entity: 

1) VAT proof: we can provide the UK VAT registration certificate and a VAT summary page from HMRC. Which of these is acceptable for Redwood for EU VAT validation?

2) PO entity mapping: you have two Redwood buying entities in the UK/IE region (Redwood UK Ltd / Redwood EMEA Ops Ltd). For multi-entity billing, do you prefer us to split invoices by entity or send a single invoice and have Redwood re-allocate?

3) Reverse-charge / withholding: do you require any specific tax residency attestation from our side for reverse-charge treatment on services? We have a signed corporate residency letter ready if that helps.

We can attach the VAT certificate and a preliminary PO mapping spreadsheet if you'd like to review.

Attaching: OMN-VAT-CERT.pdf (VAT registration certificate)

Best,
Ethan Walsby
Head of Finance Operations
Omnicommerce Ltd
attachments: OMN-VAT-CERT.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Walsby <supply@omnicommerce.co.uk>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - VAT evidence + PO mapping questions

Hi Ethan — great to hear and thanks for the certificate. Quick answers and next steps below. Looping Laura (finance AP) and Ben (tax) to confirm required evidence.

Summary answers:
- VAT certificate: yes, the UK VAT registration certificate (PDF) is sufficient for initial validation. Laura, can you confirm if we also need an HMRC portal screenshot?
- PO entity mapping: Redwood prefers invoices tied to the legal entity that matches the PO. If Omnicommerce can split invoices by Redwood legal entity (Redwood UK Ltd vs Redwood EMEA Ops Ltd) that's cleaner and avoids internal reallocation. If splitting is difficult, we can accept single invoices but require a clear PO line mapping on the invoice.
- Reverse charge / residency: we typically require a signed tax residency attestation for non-US suppliers when reverse-charge is claimed. A corporate residency letter or local tax authority statement is OK.

Next steps for Omnicommerce:
1) Please send the signed tax residency attestation (PDF) and attach your usual bank details page.
2) If possible, upload a CSV mapping: vendor_legal_name, vendor_vat, redwood_entity, preferred_po_prefix. I attached a short template (PO-ENTITY-MAP.csv) for convenience.
3) Indicate whether you will split invoices by Redwood entity or provide a single invoice with PO-level splits.

We can start test POs once Laura confirms the documentation. Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded this week.

—Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - VAT evidence + PO mapping questions

Hi Ethan — 

Thanks for the certificate. A few clarifications from Finance / Tax here at Redwood: 

Attachments we need (final set):
- Signed Tax Residency Attestation (company letterhead, dated) — OMN-TAX-ATTESTATION-signed.pdf
- VAT registration certificate (you already sent) — OMN-VAT-CERT.pdf
- Bank details page for wire setup (for payments)
- Optional: HMRC VAT online view screenshot if available (helps fast-track validation)

PO / Invoice routing guidance (short):
- Preferred: split invoices per Redwood legal entity. That means you submit one invoice per Redwood entity and reference the corresponding PO number. This avoids manual reallocation and speeds payment.
- Acceptable alternative: single invoice with line-level PO references that clearly map to different Redwood entities. If you choose this, please ensure every invoice line includes PO number and the Redwood legal entity code (example: RDW-UK / RDW-EMEA).

PO filename/numbering recommendation (helps our AP automation):
- Please include a short vendor prefix and the Redwood entity code in the invoice reference. Example: OMN-INV_RDW-UK_202705 (we will match this to PO-ENTITY-MAP.csv).

Ive attached a small CSV template for the PO entity mapping (PO-ENTITY-MAP.csv). Populate the columns below: vendor_legal_name, vendor_vat, redwood_entity_code, preferred_po_prefix. Once you return the completed CSV and the signed attestation we will: 
1) Create vendor records in our AP system (Coupa-esque)
2) Issue test POs to your nominated billing contact (we typically do a $0.01 test line for mapping verification)
3) Move to active supplier with standard 30-day terms (unless contract specifies otherwise)

If you prefer, we can do a 15-min screen share to walk through the CSV template — say the word.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager — AP/Payables
Redwood Inference
attachments: PO-ENTITY-MAP.csv
